airier.definition:
s. open to or abounding in fresh air
s. not practical or realizable; speculative
s. having little or no perceptible weight; so light as to resemble air
airier.translation: a. 空气的( airy的比较级 ); 空中的; 轻快的; 通风的

airiest.definition:
s. open to or abounding in fresh air
s. not practical or realizable; speculative
s. having little or no perceptible weight; so light as to resemble air
airiest.translation: a. 空气的( airy的最高级 ); 空中的; 轻快的; 通风的

airily.translation: adv. 轻盈地, 快活地

airiness.definition:
n. the property of something spacious and abounding in fresh air
n. the property of something weightless and insubstantial
n. lightness in movement or manner
airiness.translation: n. 通风, 轻快, 轻浮, 虚无缥渺

airing.definition: n. a short excursion (a walk or ride) in the open air
airing.translation:
n. 晾, 通风, 兜风
[化] 充气

airing cupboard.translation: n. 晾衣橱; 保暖衣橱

airings.definition:
plural of airing
n. a short excursion (a walk or ride) in the open air
airings.translation:
(airing 的复数) n. 晾, 通风, 兜风
[化] 充气
